name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana
benefit:
- Accidental medical treatment:

   1. Registered workers will be eligible for a one-time payment of up to ₹20,000/- for medical treatment due to an accident.
   1. Additionally, they will be eligible for ₹1,000/- for a vision aid (glasses), ₹5,000/- for artificial teeth, and ₹6,000/- for a hearing aid.
   1. If a worker is hospitalized for more than 15 days, they will be eligible for reimbursemen
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant must be registered with labor board.
1. Applicant age must be between 18 to 60 years.
